---
title: "Feungal refseq prevalence"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r , fig.width=5, fig.height=4.5}

install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("readr")
install.packages("dplyr")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# Input file 
input_file <- "/scratch/prj/rosetree/Valentina/results/downstream/refseq/filtered/refseq_fungal_genus.taxon_summary_after_total_filter.tsv"

# Output plot 
output_file <- "/scratch/prj/rosetree/Valentina/results/downstream/refseq/summary/refseq_fungal_prevalence_vs_abundance.png"

# Load data
df <- read_tsv(input_file) %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_group = ifelse(prevalence_fraction >= 0.02,
                             "Kept (≥2%)",
                             "Removed (<2%)")
  )

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = total_count, y = prevalence_fraction, color = threshold_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.02,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "#D55E00"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Removed (<2%)" = "#999999",
    "Kept (≥2%)" = "#0072B2"
  )) +
  
  labs(
    title = "RefSeq fungal genera: prevalence vs abundance",
    x = "Total abundance (log scale)",
    y = "Prevalence (fraction of samples)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "Nimbus Sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "#333333"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

p

ggsave(
  "/scratch/prj/rosetree/Valentina/results/downstream/refseq/summary/refseq_fungal_prevalence_vs_abundance.png",
  p,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(output_file, p, width = 5, height = 4.5)

cat("Plot saved to:", output_file, "\n")
```
